definition: In the Grim Placer thought experiment, a Fred particle marks a warrant by occupying a position. Position persistence here means that this created-and-placed particle continues to occupy that position throughout the later remainder of the same stipulated GP sequence. It is within-sequence temporal persistence at a location, not existence in every possible world, necessary existence, persistence of every physical object or mere preservation of an abstract signal message.
